A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 20-page versions of CARE, including Supplementary Material Sections 6–11. Text extraction and rendered-page inspection support reliable comparison of their equations, figures, tables and appendices.

before.justification: v1 reports original CARE benchmark results in Tables 1–2, training and component analyses, and additional appendix ablations and case studies.

after.justification: v2 retains the same original benchmark results, training analyses, ablations and appendix case studies.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithm 1 retain identical anchor selection, hard-negative selection, subgroup normalization, negative scaling, reflection-guided resampling, all-negative rescue and token-weighted objectives.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same ChartQA, Geometry3K and ViRL39K training mixture and Vision-R1-cold initialization data. Evaluation retains the same six benchmark settings covering MathVista, MathVerse, MATH-Vision, MMMU and both MMMU-Pro variants.

E2.justification: Tables 1–2 and the ablations retain the same comparators, including GRPO, DAPO and GSPO. Citation renumbering does not change comparator membership.

E3.justification: Sections 4.1 and 8 and Table 5 retain the same backbones, splits, training settings, eight-rollout budget and evaluation procedures, including single-decode inference and GPT-5 judging of open-ended answers.

E4.justification: The component, reflection, negative-selection, scaling, rescue and region-weighting analyses are unchanged. Appendix Section 9 retains the same subgroup-size, equalization, anchor and reflection-scaling ablations; Section 11 retains all four cases.

E5.justification: Both versions specify five independent seeds and the same 95% confidence-interval calculation in Section 8.2. Confidence bands, error bars and per-seed reporting remain unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical results, plotted findings and case outcomes match. For example, Table 2 retains Qwen2.5-VL-7B macro accuracy of 50.57 for CARE versus 45.95 for GRPO, a 4.62-point difference.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(14), the mathematical assumptions and Appendix Section 7's proposition, derivation and two corollaries are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same failure-centric training contributions, unchanged inference-cost claim and reported accuracy and stability claims.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and mechanism explanations are identical. Section 10 retains the same limitations concerning verifiable rewards, extremely difficult tasks and potential brevity bias, along with unchanged future directions.

D1.justification: Sections 8.1–8.3, Algorithm 1 and Table 5 retain identical preprocessing, implementation and hyperparameter information. No code or data access instructions are added or removed.

R1.justification: The standalone TIGER-Lab ViRL39K dataset reference in v1 [35] disappears; its Section 2 citation instead points to VL-Rethinker in v2 [34], duplicating v2 [35]. Other changes largely revise metadata for already named methods, while the research-positioning discussion remains unchanged.

P1.justification: Several bibliography entries receive revised authors, titles, publication details or identifiers, with corresponding citation renumbering and an updated arXiv version/date stamp. The narrative, terminology and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Revised bibliography entries reorder and reflow across PDF pages 9–10. All 16 figures and five tables retain their structure and placement; table citation numbers change without redesign.

improvement.justification: The scientific content and evidence are unchanged. v2 adds bibliographic identifiers and fuller publication details, but also replaces the standalone ViRL39K reference with duplicate VL-Rethinker entries. The supplied PDFs cannot establish whether the author/title substitutions correct earlier errors, so the net quality effect of this bibliography-focused revision remains uncertain.
